text_block_list.text:
I got so absorbed in my work that it got 
late. As I was rushing back home...

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"...I just couldn't get the race off my 
mind. I thought going for a run might 
clear my head, but—"

text_block_list.name: Biwa Hayahide
text_block_list.text:
"Haaah... It won't go that smoothly, huh. 
Which strategy should I employ next...?"

It looks like fatigue from the race has 
built up... I should probably reconsider 
her upcoming race schedule.
